none: PAS YORYM-BF55B1: Roman : Samian Ware Vessel Sherd
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A fragment of a wheel thrown ceramic vessel of Roman date, circa AD 43 - 400. The fragment is a body sherd from a Terra sigillata, or samian ware, vessel and is of Dragendorff Type 37. The fabric is orange with a soft soapy texture and a glossy red slip on both interior and exterior surface.
